Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. import yaml
import requests
import re
import time
import sys

YAML_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/literature_map.yaml"
BIB_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper/references.bib"

with open(YAML_PATH) as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

papers = data.get("papers", {})

# Filter
to_include = []
for key, p in papers.items():
    if not p.get("verified", False):
        continue
    to_include.append((key, p))

# Sort by bibtex_key
to_include.sort(key=lambda x: x[1].get("bibtex_key", x[0]))

def fetch_doi_bibtex(doi, timeout=15):
    """Fetch BibTeX from DOI resolver."""
    try:
        url = f"https://doi.org/{doi}"
        r = requests.get(url, headers={"Accept": "application/x-bibtex"}, timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=True)
        if r.status_code == 200 and "@" in r.text:
            return r.text.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  DOI fetch failed for {doi}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return None

def format_authors(authors):
    """Format author list for BibTeX."""
    formatted = []
    for a in authors:
        parts = a.strip().split()
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            last = parts[-1]
            first = " ".join(parts[:-1])
            formatted.append(f"{last}, {first}")
        else:
            formatted.append(a)
    return " and ".join(formatted)

def escape_bibtex(s):
    """Escape special chars in BibTeX values."""
    # Protect acronyms
    for acr in ["LLM", "LLMs", "NER", "IE", "NLP", "GPT", "BERT", "CRF", "FSM", "CFG", "MT", "QA",
                 "OOD", "OOV", "DNN", "DNNs", "MMLU", "GSM8K", "BoN", "MBR", "RAPS",
                 "SciERC", "CoNLL", "WNUT", "GoLLIE", "UniNER", "SelfCheckGPT",
                 "E-NER", "ReASC", "CISC", "USC", "RASC", "CoCoA", "LSC"]:
        s = re.sub(rf'\b{re.escape(acr)}\b', '{' + acr + '}', s)
    return s

def determine_entry_type(paper):
    """Determine BibTeX entry type from venue."""
    venue = paper.get("venue", "").lower()
    if any(k in venue for k in ["iclr", "icml", "neurips", "nips", "emnlp", "acl", "naacl", "eacl",
                                  "coling", "conll", "aaai", "ijcai", "sigkdd", "kdd", "hlt",
                                  "workshop", "w-nut", "findings"]):
        return "inproceedings"
    if any(k in venue for k in ["journal", "tacl", "bulletin", "transactions", "genomics",
                                  "informatics", "société"]):
        return "article"
    if "arxiv" in venue.lower() or "preprint" in venue.lower():
        return "article"
    return "inproceedings"

def make_booktitle(venue):
    """Convert venue to booktitle/journal."""
    return venue

def build_manual_entry(key, paper):
    """Build BibTeX entry manually."""
    bkey = paper.get("bibtex_key", key)
    etype = determine_entry_type(paper)
    title = escape_bibtex(paper.get("title", ""))
    authors = format_authors(paper.get("authors", []))
    year = paper.get("year", "")
    venue = paper.get("venue", "")
    url = paper.get("url", "")

    lines = [f"@{etype}{{{bkey},"]
    lines.append(f"  title = {{{title}}},")
    lines.append(f"  author = {{{authors}}},")

    if etype == "inproceedings":
        lines.append(f"  booktitle = {{{venue}}},")
    else:
        if "arxiv" in venue.lower() or "preprint" in venue.lower():
            # Extract arXiv ID from URL
            arxiv_match = re.search(r'arxiv\.org/abs/(\d+\.\d+)', url)
            if arxiv_match:
                lines.append(f"  journal = {{arXiv preprint arXiv:{arxiv_match.group(1)}}},")
            else:
                lines.append(f"  journal = {{{venue}}},")
        else:
            lines.append(f"  journal = {{{venue}}},")

    lines.append(f"  year = {{{year}}},")
    if url:
        lines.append(f"  url = {{{url}}}")
    lines.append("}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def replace_key_in_bibtex(bibtex_str, new_key):
    """Replace the citation key in a fetched BibTeX entry."""
    return re.sub(r'(@\w+)\{[^,]+,', rf'\1{{{new_key},', bibtex_str, count=1)

# Fetch DOI-based entries
doi_results = {}
doi_papers = [(k, p) for k, p in to_include if p.get("doi", "").strip()]
print(f"Fetching BibTeX for {len(doi_papers)} papers with DOIs...", file=sys.stderr)

for key, p in doi_papers:
    doi = p["doi"].strip()
    bkey = p.get("bibtex_key", key)
    print(f"  Fetching {bkey} (DOI: {doi})...", file=sys.stderr)
    result = fetch_doi_bibtex(doi)
    if result:
        result = replace_key_in_bibtex(result, bkey)
        doi_results[bkey] = result
        print(f"    OK", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print(f"    FAILED - will build manually", file=sys.stderr)
    time.sleep(0.3)

# Build final .bib
entries = []
supplementary_count = 0
normal_count = 0

for key, p in to_include:
    bkey = p.get("bibtex_key", key)
    role = p.get("role", "")
    is_supp = role == "supplementary"

    if bkey in doi_results:
        entry_text = doi_results[bkey]
    else:
        entry_text = build_manual_entry(key, p)

    if is_supp:
        entry_text = f"% SUPPLEMENTARY — not cited in main text\n{entry_text}"
        supplementary_count += 1
    else:
        normal_count += 1

    entries.append(entry_text)

# Write
header = "% Auto-generated from literature_map.yaml — do not edit manually\n"
content = header + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(entries) + "\n"

with open(BIB_PATH, "w") as f:
    f.write(content)

print(f"\nDone. Written {len(entries)} entries ({normal_count} normal + {supplementary_count} supplementary) to {BIB_PATH}", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"DOI-fetched: {len(doi_results)}, manually built: {len(entries) - len(doi_results)}", file=sys.stderr)
